description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableMessagePath class, including tests for immutability, equality, null handling, and parsing functions related to message direction and feature IDs.

classes.name: ImmutableMessagePathTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of ImmutableMessagePath, including immutability, equality, null handling, and parsing logic for message direction and feature IDs.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableMessagePath instances are immutable, considering JsonPointer instances as also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods of ImmutableMessagePath using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableMessagePath with a null JsonPointer throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: parseDirection
methods.description: Tests that the getDirection method correctly identifies message direction (FROM or TO) based on the JSON pointer path.

methods.name: parseFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that the getFeatureId method correctly extracts feature ID from the JSON pointer path.
